svg.title: Outreach Agent at a glance
svg.desc: Telegram and the owner dashboard share one LangGraph agent and saved queue. Questions, files and web research return sourced answers. Explicit email requests prepare Gmail drafts. Progress is saved in SQLite or PostgreSQL.
